meta.title: Animals: how big they were | Museum of Ages
meta.description: How big the museum's animals were, each beside a person 1.70 m tall to one scale, in our own pictures with their sources.
meta.og_image_alt: A shark with its mouth open, seen from the side, dark grey with a paler band along the flank, beside a grey person who looks tiny next to it.
meta.credit: Museum of Ages, body shape after Shimada and others 2025 (CC BY 4.0)

top.answer: The museum is building a wing of animals, from the giants of long ago to the last of their kind. Until it opens, each page here answers one question: how big was this animal? Our own picture puts it beside a person of 1.70 m, to one scale, with the numbers and what they rest on.

out.text: Museum of Ages is a digital museum. Open today is the Leonardo da Vinci wing. Free entry, no account.

items.alt: A shark with its mouth open, seen from the side, dark grey with a paler band along the flank, beside a grey person who looks tiny next to it.
Seven dinosaurs in a row from the side, two with long necks towering over the rest, and a grey person who looks tiny beside them.
A T. rex from the side on two legs, mouth open and head raised, beside a grey person who stands far below its hips.
A Spinosaurus with a tall sail and a deep tail, the pale outline of a larger adult behind it, beside a grey person who reaches its hip.
A woolly mammoth from the side in a dark brown coat: high domed head, sloping back, two curved tusks, a mark at the shoulder. The grey person beside him stands lower than the tusk tips.

A Brachiosaurus from the side, its long neck raised in a gentle curve, the front legs longer than the hind legs, the tail off the ground, beside a grey person who could walk under its belly, a short bar marking the head's top.

A Triceratops from the side: a wide frill behind the head, two long horns over the eyes, a short one on the nose, four legs. Beside it a grey person who reaches about two thirds of the way up its back.

An Ankylosaurus from the side: a low, wide body under rows of bony plates, a broad head carried low, four short legs and a straight tail ending in a flat club. Beside it a grey person, as tall as the top of its back over the hips.
